vachanas.kannada:
ಅಂಗವೇ ಆಧಾರ, ಲಿಂಗವೆ ಜೀವ.
ಈ ಅಂಗಲಿಂಗದಿಂದವೆ ಸ್ವರ.
ಲಿಂಗವು ಮಹಾಬೇಳಗಾಗಲಿಕ್ಕಾಗಿ,
ಅಶ್ವಥರಾಮ ಹಗಲು ಬಯಲು.
vachanas.transliteration:
aṅgavē ādhāra, liṅgave jīva.
ī aṅgaliṅgadindave svara.
liṅgavu mahābēḷagāgalikkāgi,
aśvatharāma hagalu bayalu.
vachanas.translation:
The body is the foundation; the Liṅga is life itself.
From the union of this body and the Liṅga arises the Divine Sound.
So that the Liṅga may shine forth as the Great Radiance,
Aśvattharāma abides in the boundless Light of the eternal day.

vachanas.kannada:
ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣನಲ್ಲ, ಪ್ರದೇಶಿಕನಲ್ಲ,
ನಿರತಿಶಯದೊಳತಿಶಯ ತಾ ಮುನ್ನಲ್ಲ.
ಶರಣನಲ್ಲ, ಐಕ್ಯನಲ್ಲ, ಪರಮನಲ್ಲ, ಜೀವನಲ್ಲ,
ನಿರವಯನಲ್ಲ, ಸಾವಯನಲ್ಲ;
ಪರವಿಹವೆಂಬುಭಯದೊಳಿಲ್ಲದವನು.
ನಿರಾಲಯ ನಿಜಗುರು ಶಾಂತೇಶ್ವರನ ಶರಣನ ನಿಲವು
ಉಪಮೆಗೆ ತಾನನುಪಮ.
vachanas.transliteration:
paripūrṇanalla, pradēśikanalla,
niratiśayadoḷatiśaya tā munnalla.
śaraṇanalla, aikyanalla, paramanalla, jīvanalla,
niravayanalla, sāvayanalla;
paravihavembubhayadoḷilladavanu.
nirālaya nijaguru śāntēśvarana śaraṇana nilavu
upamege tānanupama.
vachanas.translation:
He is not merely the Perfect One, nor is He confined to any particular place.
Within the unsurpassable, He is the unsurpassable Excellence itself.
He is neither a Śaraṇa, nor one who has attained union, nor the Supreme, nor the individual soul.
He is neither without parts nor possessed of parts.
He is beyond both the transcendent and the immanent.
The state of the devotee of the true Guru, Nirālaya Śāntēśvara,
Is incomparable—having none to which it may be compared.
